name: ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES_ADDRESS
description: The Auth Entities Address table contains multiple address line data as it pertains to a single entity outlined in the Auth Entities table.

columns.name: AUTH_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the auth bundle record.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE
columns.description: The line number of the associated entity in the auth bundle. Together with AUTH_BUNDLE_ID, this forms the foreign key to the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: VALUE_LINE
columns.description: The line number of one of the multiple entity address values associated with the auth bundle and the auth entitty from the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: ENTITY_ST_ADDR
columns.description: The street address associated with the entity's address information.
